title: Tdarr
description: Is Tdarr keeping up, and how much space has it saved?

list.name: container
list.label: Container
list.description: The Tdarr container's name, for its CPU, memory and logs.

panels.title: Tdarr
panels.description: Whether the exporter can read Tdarr's API. Down: Tdarr's server isn't answering (or its API key, with Tdarr's login on, is wrong).

panels.title: Version
panels.description: Tdarr server version.

panels.title: Files
panels.description: Files in the selected libraries.

panels.title: Transcode queue
panels.description: Files waiting for a transcode.

panels.title: Health-check queue
panels.description: Files waiting for a health check.

panels.title: Transcode errors
panels.description: Files whose transcode failed. They stay in Tdarr's Transcode: Error/Cancelled list until they're requeued or cleared there.

panels.title: Health-check errors
panels.description: Files whose health check failed (often a damaged file). They stay in Tdarr's Health check: Error/Cancelled list until they're requeued or cleared there.

panels.title: Space saved
panels.description: Space transcoding has saved in the selected libraries (negative: files grew).

panels.title: Workers
panels.description: What each running worker is doing. Progress and ETA are Tdarr's own estimates; Est. size is the output's expected size.

targets.expr: max by (worker_id, node_name, worker_type, compute_type, file) (label_replace(tdarr_node_worker_info, "file", "$1", "worker_file", "(?:.*/)?(.+)"))

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: Each Tdarr node: whether it's paused, whether its schedule is on (it then works only in the hours the schedule allows), its running workers against its limits (CPU + GPU), and the host's CPU and memory as the node sees them.

panels.title: Completed per hour
panels.description: Transcodes and health checks Tdarr finished, per hour.

panels.title: Queues and errors
panels.description: Files waiting for a transcode or health check, and files whose last one failed.

panels.title: Space saved per library
panels.description: Space transcoding has saved in each library (negative: files grew).

panels.title: Workers running
panels.description: Running workers by type, on CPU or GPU.

panels.title: Transcode speed
panels.description: Frames per second, summed over each node's workers.

panels.title: Libraries
panels.description: Each library's files by their last transcode result. Not required: the flow or plugins decided the file was already as wanted. Transcodes: completed over the library's life.

targets.expr: sum by (library_name) (tdarr_library_transcodes{status="not required"} * on (tdarr_instance, library_id) group_left (library_name) tdarr_library_info{library_name=~"$library"})

panels.title: Video codecs
panels.description: Files in the selected libraries by video codec: how much is left in older codecs.

panels.title: Resolutions
panels.description: Files in the selected libraries by video resolution.

panels.title: Container CPU
panels.description: CPU the Tdarr container uses (cores; transcodes on the GPU use little).

panels.title: Container memory
panels.description: Memory the Tdarr container uses (working set).

panels.title: Errors and warnings
panels.description: Tdarr's own log lines tagged ERROR or WARN, newest first.
